description: Scrape Dubizzle UAE classified listings across motors, property, jobs, classifieds and community services. Provide category or search URLs, or pick a category plus keyword and city. Independent tool, not affiliated with Dubizzle.

bedroomsMax.description: Property only. Maximum number of bedrooms.
bedroomsMax.title: Maximum Bedrooms

bedroomsMin.description: Property only. Minimum number of bedrooms.
bedroomsMin.title: Minimum Bedrooms

category.description: Dubizzle section to scrape. Choose All categories to search everywhere, or pick a specific section such as used cars, apartments for rent, jobs or electronics.
category.title: Category

furnishing.description: Property only. Keep furnished or unfurnished homes, or any.
furnishing.title: Furnishing

ignoreUrlFailures.description: Keep going with the remaining searches when one search still fails after its retries.
ignoreUrlFailures.title: Ignore Search Failures

keyword.description: Optional search text, for example Toyota, iPhone 15, apartment or a job title. Works across all categories and together with URLs.
keyword.sectionDescription: Choose a category, city and optional keyword. Ignored only for the city and category parts when URLs are provided.
keyword.title: Search Keyword

location.description: UAE city or emirate to search in. Choose All UAE to search the whole country.
location.title: City / Emirate

maxItems.description: Maximum listings to save for each URL or keyword/category search. Duplicates across searches are removed.
maxItems.title: Max Items Per Search

maxKilometers.description: Motors only. Maximum listed odometer reading in kilometres.
maxKilometers.title: Maximum Odometer (km)

maxPages.description: Safety cap on result pages fetched per search. 0 means automatic, stopping at maxItems or when results run out.
maxPages.title: Max Pages Per Search

maxRetries.description: Retries for rate limits and temporary Dubizzle search errors.
maxRetries.title: Max Retries Per Page

postedWithinDays.description: Only collect listings added to Dubizzle during this window.
postedWithinDays.title: Posted Within

priceMax.description: Optional maximum asking price in AED.
priceMax.title: Maximum Price (AED)

priceMin.description: Optional minimum asking price in AED. Listings without a price (many jobs and services) are excluded when this is set.
priceMin.sectionDescription: Optional price, size and vehicle filters. Filters that do not apply to the chosen category are ignored with a note in the run log.
priceMin.title: Minimum Price (AED)

sellerType.description: Filter by seller. Owner, dealer and rental apply to motors; individual and business apply to classifieds, jobs and community listings. Property seller filtering is not exposed by Dubizzle and is ignored with a note.
sellerType.title: Seller Type

sortBy.description: Order in which listings are collected. Relevance uses Dubizzle's default ranking.
sortBy.title: Sort Results

startUrls.description: One or more Dubizzle UAE category or search page URLs, for example https://dubai.dubizzle.com/motors/used-cars/ or https://abudhabi.dubizzle.com/property-for-rent/residential/apartmentflat/. When provided, the city and category come from each URL and the category dropdown is ignored. Keyword and filter fields still apply.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Paste Dubizzle category or search pages. Leave empty to search by category, keyword and city instead.
startUrls.title: Category or Search URLs

title: Dubizzle UAE Listings Scraper
